name: Sekitani Jun
source: Due to his parents moving away, Jun has to go live in an apartment complex owned by Miyuki. Soon he becomes a plaything of perverted 'oneesans' living in the adjacent apartments. Even though he feels an obligation to study, enter a good school and become a Buddhist priest, soon Jun succumbs to the sexy wiles of his neighbours.
